title: Students protest in Hyderabad demanding case against agricultural university VC
seoTitle: Hyderabad students protest against varsity VC

tea.why: Students protested because police allegedly failed to issue an acknowledgment receipt for a sexual harassment complaint against the VC.
tea.want: Protesters demanded that police register a case against the Vice-Chancellor and sought justice for the complainant.
tea.changed: Nov 11: Students staged a midnight protest in Rajendranagar demanding action against the university VC.

summary: Students in Rajendranagar, Hyderabad, staged a midnight protest demanding that police register a case against Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University Vice-Chancellor Prof. Aldas Janaiah. The protest followed allegations of sexual harassment made by an assistant professor against the Vice-Chancellor. The demonstrators raised slogans and expressed anger that the police had allegedly failed to issue an acknowledgment receipt after a complaint was submitted at the police station. The complainant stated she faced harassment and career threats, and had approached various authorities including the Women's Wing, the Director General of Police, and the Governor. Meanwhile, the Telangana State Commission for Women issued a notice to the Vice-Chancellor, while Prof. Aldas Janaiah dismissed the allegations as false and politically motivated.
demands: Register a police case against the Vice-Chancellor
response: The Telangana State Commission for Women issued notices to the Vice-Chancellor. Vice-Chancellor Prof. Aldas Janaiah dismissed the allegations as false rumors driven by vindictiveness and internal conspiracies.

updates.text: Students staged a midnight protest in Rajendranagar demanding police action against the university Vice-Chancellor.
